items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: I took music lessons with old man Chalini.

ctx.x: How long did you take lessons from T.O.? You said in about six months you could play. Well, I took lessons on instrument to start playing.

Then I continued my lessons after music. Yes, you kept on going. Yeah, I continued taking music lessons. Then I had music lessons. I took music lessons with my sister. I took music lessons with T.O. I took music lessons with old man Chalini.
